summary: Closing the last realism gap in the evidence. The successor keeps the joint-implicit removal prefix and all eighteen invocation cases, and adds a run of the logical clock: ten rounds in which every node receives Tick with message delivery in between, so the heartbeat interval is reached while the election interval is not exceeded between rounds, followed by an explicit evaluation of the observed state as ticks_window. The assertion records that the context-free invocation was still pending after those ticks with leader 1 unchanged and the node still a voter, so the running clock itself does not release the held proposal and no election is triggered by it; a local run in the scratch copy shows the same result, with node 1 still StateLeader at term 1, node 3 seeing leader 1 as a voter, the invocation pending, and the witness, context-free, removal and configuration-proposal observations unchanged. This closes the limitation that no ticks had been delivered, which was the most likely reviewer objection to the finding. Remaining budget after this turn is roughly forty-five minutes and thirty-three executions.
